Instructions for Use
Device description: The Meridian Fixation System is a orthopedic screw system. It is available in lengths from 15 mm to 48 mm.
Warnings: For single use only. Do not resterilize. Store at 15 °C to 30 °C.
Refer to the surgical technique guide for implantation instructions.

MR Safety
The Meridian Fixation System is MR Conditional. Patients with this device can be scanned at 1.5 T when all of the following conditions are met.
General conditions:
- Maximum spatial gradient magnetic field of 19 T/m (1,900 G/cm).
- Maximum gradient slew rate of 200 T/m/s per axis.
- Scan in Normal Operating Mode.
- Any transmit coil may be used.
- WB-SAR ≤ 1.5 W/kg.
- Maximum active scan time of 20 minutes.
- Followed by a wait time of 15 minutes.
The image artifact extends approximately 20 mm from the device.
RF heating was evaluated using a body coil at 64 MHz and 128 MHz in a gel phantom.
